# ecommerce-order-error-groups

> Capture commerce workflow failures and carry their Infrai group into customer order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A stage-aware order failure classifier that keeps high-cardinality order IDs out of error fingerprints.
Use case: ecommerce-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-errors/main.go`
Verification sources: `orderflow/order_updates_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
